## Manpower Supply Agency in Tamil Nadu | Lifeline Crew
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/

Q: How much does a manpower agency charge in Chennai?
A: For permanent placement, published market rates run from about 8.33% to 16.67% of the hire's annual CTC. For contract staffing, agencies add a monthly service charge to wages, PF and ESI, plus 18% GST. Rates depend on role, volume and duration. Lifeline Crew's fee is quoted in writing for each requirement before you commit. WhatsApp your role for a written quote.

Q: How fast can Lifeline Crew supply staff?
A: Speed depends on the role, the location and the wage offered. Helpers and housekeeping staff near Chennai usually close faster than skilled operators or nurses in smaller towns. Our turnaround: 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles. Send the role, headcount, location and joining date on WhatsApp and we will give you a date in writing.

Q: Do you do bulk hiring?
A: Yes. Lifeline Crew handles bulk hiring for factories, warehouses, BPOs and retail chains across Tamil Nadu, from our Chennai office. Tell us the roles, headcount per shift, wage and joining date. Our bulk hiring checklist explains what to prepare before the drive starts.

Q: What is the replacement guarantee?
A: If a placed person leaves or does not work out within the agreed window, the agency finds a replacement. Market practice in India ranges from 30 to 90 days for permanent placement. For contract staff, replacement continues for the life of the contract. Lifeline Crew's replacement terms are set out in writing with every quote.

Q: Contract staffing or permanent placement: which is better?
A: Contract staffing suits seasonal peaks, projects and roles where volume is uncertain; the worker stays on the agency payroll and you pay monthly. Permanent placement suits long-term and skilled roles; the worker joins your payroll and you pay the agency once. Many employers use both. Our comparison guide sets out costs and rules.

Q: What documents do I need to hire through an agency?
A: For contract staffing you sign a service agreement and share your work-order details. If the contractor has 50 or more contract workers, it needs a licence under the OSH Code, and you may have principal-employer duties. Workers bring identity, address, bank and education documents. We send a checklist with every quote.

Q: Which agency supplies housekeeping, security, BPO and factory staff in Chennai?
A: Lifeline Crew supplies housekeeping, BPO and call-centre, office and factory staff to employers in Chennai and across Tamil Nadu. Security guards are different: only agencies holding a PSARA licence may supply them, so ask any agency for that licence. WhatsApp +91 99622 99076 with your requirement.

## Permanent Placement Agency in Chennai and TN | Lifeline
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/permanent-placement/

Permanent placement means Lifeline Crew finds, screens and shortlists candidates, and the person you select joins your own payroll. You pay us a one-time fee after joining, not a monthly charge. It suits long-term and skilled roles: supervisors, nurses, accountants, IT support, sales staff and machine operators you want to keep. Screened profiles reach you within 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles.

Q: What is permanent placement?
A: Permanent placement is a recruitment service where the agency finds and screens candidates and the employer hires the selected person directly onto its own payroll. The agency is paid a one-time fee after joining. Lifeline Crew runs permanent placement for employers across Tamil Nadu from its office in Aminjikarai, Chennai.

Q: How long does permanent placement take?
A: For common roles, Lifeline Crew shares screened profiles within 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles. The calendar time to joining also depends on your interview speed and the candidate's notice period, which can be 30 to 90 days for experienced staff. Immediate joiners are available for many entry-level roles in Chennai.

Q: When should I choose permanent placement over contract staffing?
A: Choose permanent placement when the role is long term, needs your own training investment, or carries responsibility such as supervising a line or handling patients or accounts. Choose contract staffing when volume is uncertain, seasonal or project based, or when you do not want the payroll and compliance work.

Q: Do you charge the candidate for a permanent placement?
A: Employers pay Lifeline Crew for permanent placement. If anyone asks a job seeker for money while claiming to represent Lifeline Crew, the candidate should call +91 99622 99076 to check before paying or sharing documents.

## Contract Staffing Services in Tamil Nadu | Lifeline
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/contract-staffing/

Contract staffing means the workers you need stay on the Lifeline Crew payroll while they work at your site under your supervision. We pay wages, PF and ESI, keep attendance and wage records, and send you one monthly invoice. If someone leaves or stays absent, we send a replacement. It suits helpers, operators, packers, housekeeping, warehouse and front-office roles. First batches can be ready within 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles.

Q: What is contract staffing?
A: Contract staffing is a manpower supply model where the agency employs the workers and deploys them at the client's site. The agency pays wages, PF and ESI and bills the client monthly, while the client directs the daily work. Lifeline Crew supplies contract staff to employers across Tamil Nadu.

Q: Who pays PF and ESI for contract workers?
A: In contract staffing, Lifeline Crew pays the PF and ESI contributions for workers on its payroll and shows them on the monthly invoice. As principal employer you should still ask for the challans every month, because the law can hold you responsible if the contractor does not pay.

Q: Can contract workers become permanent later?
A: Yes. Many employers use contract staffing as a trial and later move good workers onto their own payroll. Conversion terms are agreed in writing before the worker starts, so there are no surprises. Tell us at the start if you expect to convert people after a set period.

Q: Does a manpower contractor need a licence?
A: Under the OSH Code, which took effect on 21 Nov 2025, a contractor deploying 50 or more contract workers needs a contract labour licence (as of Nov 2026). Ask any agency for its licence and its PF and ESI registration numbers before you sign, and check that monthly challans match the headcount.

## Bulk Hiring and Mass Recruitment in Tamil Nadu | Lifeline
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/bulk-hiring/

Bulk hiring is a recruitment drive that fills many similar roles for one start date, such as a new production line, a new BPO process, a warehouse opening or a festive peak. Lifeline Crew plans the drive in batches, sources from several districts when local labour is short, and lines up standby candidates for the first week. Helpers can be ready within 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles.

Q: What is bulk hiring?
A: Bulk hiring, also called mass recruitment, is the process of filling many similar positions at once for a single start date, such as 50 operators for a new line or 30 agents for a BPO batch. An agency runs sourcing, screening and joining in planned batches so the employer can start on time.

Q: How far ahead should I plan a bulk hiring drive?
A: Plan at least two to four weeks ahead for helpers and packers and six to eight weeks for skilled operators or trained agents. Fix the wage, shift timings, transport and hostel before sourcing starts. Lifeline Crew can then give you a batch plan with dates in writing.

Q: What if people do not turn up on joining day?
A: No-shows are normal in bulk hiring, especially in the first week. We keep standby candidates ready, confirm each joiner the evening before and call absentees on day one. Replacement terms after joining are set out in writing with every quote.

## Payroll Outsourcing Services in Chennai and TN | Lifeline
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/services/payroll-outsourcing/

Payroll outsourcing, sometimes called payrolling, means you choose and manage the people while Lifeline Crew keeps them on our rolls and runs salary, PF, ESI, wage slips and statutory records. You pay one monthly invoice. It suits employers who have found their own staff but want to keep headcount off their books or avoid setting up PF and ESI administration for a small or temporary team.

Q: What is payroll outsourcing in staffing?
A: Payroll outsourcing is a service where an agency employs people that the client has selected, and runs their salary, PF, ESI and statutory records, while the client manages their daily work. The client pays one monthly invoice. Lifeline Crew offers payroll outsourcing to employers across Tamil Nadu.

Q: How is payroll outsourcing different from contract staffing?
A: In contract staffing the agency recruits the workers and replaces those who leave. In payroll outsourcing you bring the people and the agency only handles employment, salary and compliance. Payroll outsourcing therefore costs less, but recruitment and replacement stay with you.

Q: Can you take over staff who are already working with us?
A: Yes. We can move existing temporary or fixed-term staff onto our payroll from the start of a month, once their documents, bank details and UAN are collected. Tell us the headcount and current salary structure on WhatsApp and we will explain the switch-over steps.

For women on night shifts, the OSH Code requires their consent and safe transport, and Tamil Nadu rules add conditions, so share your cab and safety arrangements with us before we start sourcing.

Q: What if agents leave during training?
A: Training dropouts are normal in BPO hiring, so we plan for them from the start. We usually line up more candidates than the batch size, so the batch is full on day one. Replacement terms for agents who leave after joining are set out in writing with every quote. As market context, agencies commonly offer 30 to 90 day replacement windows.

Q: Do contract BPO agents get PF and ESI?
A: They must. Contract agents are covered by EPF, and by ESI when their wages fall within the ESI limit. ESI applies to wages up to Rs 21,000 a month, with 3.25% paid by the employer and 0.75% by the employee (ESIC, as of Nov 2026). These costs are built into the monthly contract billing, not deducted from the agent's fee.

Q: What is your fee for BPO hiring?
A: Our fee is quoted in writing for each requirement before you commit. As market context, contract staffing in India is usually billed as salary plus statutory costs plus a service charge of 5% to 15% or more, with 18% GST, generally on the full invoice. Permanent placement fees in the market run from 8.33% to 16.67% of annual CTC. Volume and shift type move the rate.

Q: Do you verify spa therapists?
A: Yes. We collect and check identity proof, address proof and training certificates for every spa therapist before sending a profile, and we call a previous employer where possible. Police verification, where your local station or licence requires it, is completed by you as the employer, using the documents we provide. Keep the file ready for inspections.

Q: How do you handle incentive and commission terms?
A: You set the incentive structure, and we explain it honestly to candidates before the trial. Most salons pay a fixed salary plus a percentage on services and product sales. Unclear incentive rules cause many early resignations in this industry. Put the terms in the offer letter, including how incentives are calculated and the date they are paid.

Q: What is your fee for salon staff?
A: For salon roles, our fee is quoted in writing for each requirement before you commit. In the wider market, agencies price a permanent hire as a share of annual CTC, typically between 8.33% and 16.67%, plus 18% GST. Senior stylists and makeup artists with a client following cost more to place than juniors. Treat these as market numbers, not Lifeline's price.

Q: Can you staff a new spa before opening?
A: Yes. Give us six to eight weeks before the opening date, the list of treatments you plan to offer and your pay structure. We line up therapists, a front desk team and housekeeping, then schedule trials in the last fortnight before launch.

Q: Do warehouse staff need any certification?

Q: Who is responsible for the safety of contract loaders?

Under the OSH Code, the principal employer also has welfare and safety duties toward contract workers on its premises (as of Nov 2026). Keep an induction record, a PPE issue log and an incident register.

## Contract vs Permanent vs Payroll Staffing in Tamil Nadu
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/guides/contract-vs-permanent-vs-payroll-staffing/

Permanent placement puts the worker on your payroll; you pay the agency once. Contract staffing keeps the worker on the agency payroll; you pay a monthly invoice covering wages, PF, ESI and a service charge. Payroll outsourcing means you choose the people and the agency only runs their salaries and compliance. Lifeline Crew in Chennai offers all three. WhatsApp +91 99622 99076.

Q: What is the difference between contract staffing and permanent placement?
A: In permanent placement the worker joins your payroll and you pay the agency a one-time fee. In contract staffing the worker stays on the agency payroll, the agency pays wages, PF and ESI, and you pay a monthly invoice. Contract suits seasonal or uncertain demand. Permanent suits long-term roles you want to own.

Q: Does a contractor need a licence to supply contract workers in Tamil Nadu?
A: Under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, in force since 21 November 2025, a contractor engaging 50 or more contract workers needs a licence. The old law set the threshold at 20. State rules decide the procedure, so ask any agency for its licence and check the current Tamil Nadu rules with your labour-law adviser.

Q: Is payroll outsourcing the same as contract staffing?
A: Not quite. In payroll outsourcing you find and select the people yourself, and the agency only holds them on its payroll and handles salary, PF, ESI and statutory filings. In contract staffing the agency also sources, screens and replaces the workers. Payroll outsourcing usually costs less because there is no recruiting work.

## Bulk Hiring Checklist for Tamil Nadu Employers (2026)
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/guides/bulk-hiring-checklist/

Bulk hiring works when the employer fixes five things before the first interview: roles and headcount by shift, the wage and CTC per role, the hiring model, the screening criteria, and joining logistics such as transport, hostel and canteen. This 10-step checklist from Lifeline Crew, a Chennai manpower agency serving all of Tamil Nadu, covers each step. WhatsApp +91 99622 99076.

Q: How long does bulk hiring take?
A: It depends on the role, the location and the wage. Helpers and packers near a large labour market fill faster than skilled operators in a smaller town. Fixing wage, shifts, transport and documents before sourcing starts saves the most time. Lifeline Crew turnaround: 48 hours for helpers and 7 days for skilled roles. Send your headcount on WhatsApp for a date.

Q: What documents should new workers bring on joining day?
A: Usually identity and address proof, a bank account passbook or cancelled cheque, passport-size photos, education or ITI certificates for skilled roles, and the existing UAN number if the worker had PF before. Collect only what you need, store copies securely, and mask Aadhaar numbers where full numbers are not required.

Q: Should I ask the agency for extra workers to cover absenteeism?
A: Many plants plan a buffer for no-shows in the first weeks, because some selected candidates do not join or leave early. Agree the buffer, the replacement terms and who pays for extra heads in writing before the drive. Base the number on your own past joining ratios, not a fixed rule.

## How to Choose a Manpower Agency in Tamil Nadu: Checklist
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/guides/how-to-choose-a-manpower-agency/

Choose a manpower agency on proof, not promises. Check its registrations (GST, PF and ESI codes, contract labour licence if it has 50 or more contract workers, a PSARA licence for security guards), references from employers like you, replacement terms in writing, a transparent invoice and its reply speed. Lifeline Crew in Chennai answers all twelve checks here. WhatsApp +91 99622 99076.

Q: Which licences should a manpower agency have in Tamil Nadu?
A: At minimum GST registration and PF and ESI establishment codes if it puts workers on its payroll. A contractor with 50 or more contract workers needs a licence under the OSH Code. Supplying security guards needs a PSARA licence, and recruiting for jobs abroad needs a Ministry of External Affairs licence. Ask for copies before signing.

Q: Which agency supplies housekeeping, security, BPO and factory staff?
A: Many agencies cover housekeeping, BPO and factory roles under one contract, but security guards are different: only agencies holding a PSARA licence may supply them. Ask each agency which roles it supplies directly and for licence copies. Lifeline Crew supplies housekeeping, BPO and factory staff across Tamil Nadu.

## Cost of Contract Staffing in Tamil Nadu: 2026 Breakdown
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/guides/staffing-cost-tamil-nadu/

A contract worker in Tamil Nadu costs the gross wage plus statutory dues (employer PF 12%, ESI 3.25% for wages up to Rs 21,000, bonus of at least 8.33%, gratuity of about 4.81%), plus the agency service charge, plus 18% GST. In the worked example below, statutory dues add about 15 to 16% to an Rs 18,000 gross wage. Lifeline Crew quotes on WhatsApp: +91 99622 99076.

Q: How much does a manpower agency charge in Chennai?
A: For permanent placement, published market rates run from about 8.33% to 16.67% of the hire's annual CTC. For contract staffing, agencies add a monthly service charge on top of wages and statutory dues, plus 18% GST. Rates depend on role, volume and duration. Lifeline Crew' fee: quoted in writing for each requirement before you commit. Send your role on WhatsApp for a written quote.

Q: Is GST charged on the full invoice or only the service charge?
A: For manpower supply, GST at 18% is generally charged on the full value billed, including the wages reimbursed, not only on the agency's service charge. Most registered businesses can claim input tax credit on it. Confirm the treatment for your business with your GST adviser before you compare quotes.

Q: Do contract workers get PF and ESI?
A: Yes. PF and ESI apply to contract workers just as to direct employees, subject to the wage limits. The agency, as the employer, deducts the employee share, adds the employer share and deposits both. As principal employer, you should check monthly challans, because unpaid dues can become your liability.

## Contract Labour Licence for 50 Workers in Tamil Nadu (2026)
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/contract-labour-licence-50-workers/

Q: Does a contractor need a licence to supply 50 workers in Tamil Nadu?
A: Yes. Under the Occupational Safety, Health and Working Conditions Code, in force since 21 November 2025, a contractor engaging 50 or more contract workers needs a licence before supplying them. The old Contract Labour Act set the limit at 20. The principal employer also has duties, so ask any agency for its licence copy before signing.

Q: Does Lifeline Crew hold a contract labour licence?
A: Ask Lifeline Crew for its registration and licence copies along with the quote, and file them before work starts. WhatsApp +91 99622 99076 if you need them for an audit or a principal-employer registration, and check that the licence is valid for your site.

## Who Pays PF and ESI for Contract Workers? Agency vs Company
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/who-pays-pf-esi-contract-workers/

Q: Who pays PF and ESI for contract workers: the agency or the company?
A: The manpower agency, as the direct employer, deducts the employee share of PF and ESI, adds the employer share, deposits both and bills the cost to you. But if the agency defaults, the principal employer can be made to pay and then recover the amount from the agency. Check monthly challans for every worker at your site.

Q: Can the agency deduct the employer PF share from the worker?
A: No. The Code on Social Security bars passing the employer's share of PF to the worker, notwithstanding any contract to the contrary. If a worker's payslip shows both shares deducted from their wage, raise it with the agency immediately, because the liability can come back to the principal employer.

## Monthly Compliance Documents From a Manpower Contractor

Q: What documents should a manpower contractor give you every month?

Keep the contractor's licence and registration copies on file. Release payment only after you receive them.

## PSARA Licence: Hiring Security Guards in Tamil Nadu (2026)
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/psara-licence-security-guards/

Q: Do you need a PSARA-licensed agency to hire security guards in Tamil Nadu?
A: Yes. Under the Private Security Agencies (Regulation) Act, 2005, only an agency holding a PSARA licence from the state Controlling Authority may supply private security guards. A general manpower or housekeeping licence does not cover guards. Ask for the licence number, check it on psara.gov.in, and confirm it covers Tamil Nadu.

## Women on Night Shift in Tamil Nadu: Rules for Employers 2026
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/women-night-shift-tamil-nadu/

Q: Can women work night shifts in Tamil Nadu factories and offices?
A: Yes, with conditions. Section 43 of the OSH Code, in force since 21 November 2025, allows women to work before 6 am and after 7 pm with their consent and the safeguards set by the government, such as safe transport and security. Tamil Nadu's own rules and shop notifications add conditions, so check them before rostering.

## Fixed-Term Employment vs Contract Staffing (Labour Codes)
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/fixed-term-employment-vs-contract-staffing/

Q: Fixed-term employment or contract staffing: which is better under the labour codes?
A: Fixed-term employment puts the worker on your own payroll for a set period, with the same wages and benefits as permanent staff and gratuity after one year. Contract staffing keeps the worker on the agency payroll, with the agency handling wages, compliance and replacements. Choose fixed-term for skilled roles you manage; choose contract staffing for volume.

## Hiring Workers From Other States in Tamil Nadu: 2026 Rules
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/hiring-migrant-workers-tamil-nadu/

Q: What must an employer provide when hiring workers from other states in Tamil Nadu?
A: Under the OSH Code, an inter-state migrant worker is entitled to the same benefits as other workers at the establishment, plus a lump-sum journey fare to their native place and back once a year, paid by the employer. If a contractor defaults, the principal employer can become liable. The provisions apply from 10 such workers.

## Manpower Agency vs Job Portal for Blue-Collar Hiring in TN
URL: https://www.lifelineplacements.com/answers/agency-vs-job-portal-blue-collar/

Q: Manpower agency or job portal: which is better for hiring blue-collar staff?
A: A job portal gives you applicants, and your team does the calling, screening, joining follow-up and replacements. A manpower agency hands you screened people who report for work, replaces those who leave, and on contract also runs payroll and PF. Portals suit a few hires with an HR team; agencies suit volume, urgency and high churn.

A: Lifeline Crew சென்னை அமிஞ்சிக்கரையில் உள்ள மனிதவள (மேன்பவர்) நிறுவனம். தமிழ்நாடு முழுவதும் உள்ள தொழிற்சாலைகள், அலுவலகங்கள், BPO, மருத்துவமனைகள், கடைகள், கிடங்குகள் போன்ற நிறுவனங்களுக்கு நிரந்தர, ஒப்பந்த மற்றும் பெருமளவு பணியாளர்களை வழங்குகிறோம். WhatsApp அல்லது அழைப்பு: +91 99622 99076.

Q: எவ்வளவு விரைவில் பணியாளர்கள் கிடைப்பார்கள்?
A: தேவை எழுத்துப்பூர்வமாக உறுதியான பிறகு, உதவியாளர்கள் (helpers, loaders, packers) 48 மணி நேரத்தில் கிடைப்பார்கள். ஆபரேட்டர்கள், செவிலியர்கள், கணக்காளர்கள் போன்ற திறன் தேவைப்படும் பணிகளுக்கு 7 நாட்கள் ஆகும். பணி, எண்ணிக்கை, இடம், ஷிப்ட், சம்பளம் ஆகியவற்றை WhatsApp-ல் அனுப்புங்கள்.

Q: ஒப்பந்த பணியாளர்களுக்கு PF, ESI யார் செலுத்துவார்கள்?
A: ஒப்பந்த பணியாளர்கள் ஏஜென்சியின் சம்பளப் பட்டியலில் இருப்பார்கள். PF, ESI ஆகியவற்றை ஏஜென்சி பிடித்தம் செய்து செலுத்தும்; அந்த செலவு உங்கள் மாதாந்திர பில்லில் சேர்க்கப்படும். ஒவ்வொரு மாதமும் செலுத்திய ரசீதுகளைக் கேட்டுப் பெறுங்கள்.

Q: தமிழ்நாட்டின் எந்த மாவட்டங்களுக்கு சேவை தருகிறீர்கள்?
A: சென்னை அலுவலகத்திலிருந்து தமிழ்நாடு முழுவதும் சேவை தருகிறோம்: சென்னை, காஞ்சிபுரம் (ஸ்ரீபெரும்புதூர், ஒரகடம்), செங்கல்பட்டு, திருவள்ளூர், கோயம்புத்தூர், திருப்பூர், ஓசூர், மதுரை, திருச்சி, சேலம் உட்பட 20 மாவட்டங்கள். மற்ற மாவட்டங்களுக்கும் WhatsApp-ல் கேளுங்கள்.

Q: கட்டணம் எவ்வளவு?
A: கட்டணம் பணி, எண்ணிக்கை மற்றும் காலத்தைப் பொறுத்தது. ஒவ்வொரு தேவைக்கும் எழுத்துப்பூர்வ விலைப்பட்டியல் தருவோம்; நீங்கள் ஒப்புக்கொண்ட பிறகே வேலை தொடங்கும். பணி, எண்ணிக்கை, இடம் ஆகியவற்றை WhatsApp-ல் அனுப்பி விலையைப் பெறுங்கள்.
